designationHistory.indexText: Arrowwood Wetland Management District was established to acquire and protect waterfowl production areas in North Dakota.

authority.citation: Small Wetlands Acquisition Program (Migratory Bird Hunting and Conservation Stamp Act, as amended 1958)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

review.note: Draft sentence described Arrowwood NWR (1935), not the district. District: 1961 per FWS complex planning document. Exact date not found.
